variants.title: General tour
variants.eyebrow: BERLIN THEN AND NOW · WALK WITH YUSUF
variants.headline: See the Berlin that vanished.
variants.description: Walk from Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt with me. An archive photograph at every stop shows the streets, buildings and squares that stood here before.
variants.heroImageAlt: Yusuf in front of Berlin’s Rotes Rathaus

variants.title: Meta C1 · Marienkirche before and after
variants.headline: Walk the Berlin that disappeared.
variants.description: Marienkirche survived. The streets around it did not. Walk there with me and see the old city in archive photographs.
variants.heroImageAlt: Marienkirche and the houses of Berlin’s Neuer Markt around 1880
variants.comparisonImageAlt: Marienkirche beside the Berlin TV Tower in August 2025
variants.introLabel: Look at the two photographs. Then stand there with me.

variants.title: Meta C2 · Archive print at Humboldt Forum
variants.eyebrow: AN ARCHIVE PHOTO AT EVERY STOP
variants.headline: An archive photo at every stop.
variants.description: At the Humboldt Forum, I hold up a photograph of the Palast der Republik that once stood here. From Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt, I show you the old city through photographs of the same places.
variants.heroImageAlt: Yusuf holding an archive photograph of the Palast der Republik at the Humboldt Forum
variants.imageCredit: BerlinWalk photo. Archive print: Bundesarchiv, Bild 183-R0519-0191 / Franke, Klaus / CC-BY-SA 3.0 DE
variants.imageCaption: The Humboldt Forum, with the building that stood here before
variants.introLabel: Bring your phone. Compare today’s view with my print.

variants.title: Meta C3 · Guest reviews and guide
variants.eyebrow: BERLIN’S ORIGINS · TOLD WHERE THEY HAPPENED
variants.headline: The old city is still here to be found.
variants.description: Meet me at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz. I will show you the city that stood here before, with an archive photograph at every stop and time for your questions.
variants.heroImageAlt: Yusuf in front of Berlin’s Rotes Rathaus
variants.introLabel: Read what guests said about my earlier walking tours.

variants.description: From the World Clock to Hackescher Markt, I bring archive photographs to the places where they were taken. See how Berlin’s old city changed, in a group of no more than ten people.
